product_metadata.title: Wilton Easy Flex Silicone Spatula Set, Your Go-To Tools for Mixing, Folding, Scraping, Cooking and Serving., Blue, 3-Piece
features: SUPERIOR DURABILITY: Silicone spatulas are your go-to tools for mixing, folding, scraping, cooking and even serving. High-heat resistant silicone heads (up to 500 degrees), so they're not just for mixing, and they're stain and odor resistant.
SMALL SPATULA: This mini spatula is designed specifically for scraping jars so you can easily spread jams or jellies, peanut butter, mayonnaise and other condiments.

ALL-PURPOSE SPATUALA: This all-purpose spatula is perfect for mixing batter, folding dough and scraping the mixing bowl. It's also commonly used to make fluffy and delicious scrambled eggs without damaging the pan.

THE SPOONULA: A 'Spoonula' is half spoon and half spatula, and this versatile style spatula is great for mixing, folding, serving and scraping. It's flexible for scraping and serving but curved for mixing and folding.

EVERYONE, EVERYWHERE, EVERY DAY: Innovative products. Mouthwatering inspiration. Fun in the kitchen. This has been at the heart of what we do for nearly 90 years. Whether you’re hosting a party or need to bring a special treat, Wilton has you covered.
description: Wilton Easy Flex Silicone Spatula Set, is perfect for all your baking and cooking needs. This 3-piece silicone set includes the popular Spoonula, and a small and medium spatula. Whether you’re folding a batter, mixing a cake, or smoothing out some frosting, these tools will make the job easy and fun. The silicone head is firm enough to easily to fold dough, yet flexible enough for making fluffy scrambled eggs. The clear acrylic handle is hourglass shaped to fit comfortably in your hand. The silicone head detaches for easy cleaning and both pieces are dishwasher safe. Plus, they're stain-resistant to stay looking like new longer. Simple to clean and dishwasher safe. Silicon will stand up to the heat, up to 500 degrees making them excellent for serving hot meals as well. Wilton helps families celebrate! We inspire the joy of creativity in everyone, everywhere, every day. Since 1929, Wilton has been helping home bakers and cake decorators all over the world create sweet treats and beautiful desserts by giving them the tools to make it fun and easy. The Wilton name is known around the world for cake decorating, candy making, bakeware and party products. At Wilton, we're passionate about bringing the love of baking and decorating to every consumer.
